reused_screen.interpretation: Synthetic design and author-separated challenge evidence only; not held-out accuracy, calibration, classroom qualification, or evidence of student-level outcomes.

empty_evidence_attempt.disposition: The advisory linter refuses an empty evidence path; this did not test GR05-3 or make a Jev judgment.

bounded_review.note: The review used the saved synthetic disagreement states except GR05's empty problem was represented by a nonempty underspecified prompt because the linter rejects empty evidence. Review selections were advisory, some dimensions were low-confidence, and no contract change was justified.

source_freshness.disposition: Historical page-text hashes remain bound to the original captures. Fresh browser review of the official GOV.UK marking report and UNC conclusions handout was used only to confirm their continuing high-level motivation; it did not refresh hashes or establish Jev performance.

confirmed_defect.component: Kernel domain reference modules' missing-evidence wording
confirmed_defect.symptom: Twenty-three modules stated that code validates required fields and returns local unknown before inference, which read as behavior already implemented by the repository.
confirmed_defect.confirmed_cause: The modules described the desired consumer-side preflight as an existing runtime guarantee. The grading collection contains a catalog, fixtures, an offline receipt evaluator, pages, and tests, not an inference consumer that runs this gate. The saved empty-input probe is consistent with that boundary: Jev was still called and selected working_shown.
confirmed_defect.repair: Reworded the affected modules to require the consuming application to preflight fields and return local unknown before calling Jev. The text now distinguishes absent/schema-empty values from valid zero and false values, and says the reference modules and collection screens do not implement or verify the consumer gate.
regression_coverage: scripts/test_build_collection_pages.py checks reference modules do not reintroduce the unsupported implemented-gate sentence
